title: Create, inspect, edit, reschedule, and delete a personal task
description: A logged-in user can complete the full personal task lifecycle from creation through inspection, editing, quick status update, and deletion.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill in the task title field with a unique task name
Fill in the task description field with a brief task description
Select a valid future due date
Open the newly created task for inspection
Open the edit form for the same task
Change the task title to a revised unique task name
Open the quick status control for the same task
Verify the task is removed from the list

title: Log in and reach the dashboard
description: A returning user can log in with valid credentials and land on the task dashboard.

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the user lands on the task dashboard

title: Register a new account successfully
description: A new visitor can create an account with valid details and see a successful account creation outcome.

steps.description: Fill in the full name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a unique valid email
Fill in the password field with a strong valid password
Verify a successful account creation message is visible

title: Prevent unauthorized dashboard access
description: A visitor who is not logged in is blocked from accessing the dashboard and is redirected or denied access.

steps.description: Verify access is denied or the user is redirected to the login page

title: Block access to admin routes for non-admin users

category: Administrator User Directory and Access Control

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify access is denied or the user is redirected away from the admin tasks page
Verify access is denied or the user is redirected away from the admin users page

title: Browse system tasks and manage a user role as admin

steps.description: Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the user's role change is reflected in the directory
Verify the user workload details are visible

steps.description: Verify the user's updated role is reflected in the directory

title: Update task status and keep list order current

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Open the quick status control for a task
Verify the task reflects the updated status
Verify the task list repositions the task according to its new status

title: Combine search and status filters

Type a search term into the task search field
Verify the task list shows only results matching both the search term and selected status

title: Search tasks by title

steps.description: Type a search term into the task search field
Verify matching tasks are displayed in the task list

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Enter a task title search query
Verify the task list updates to match the combined search and filter
Verify the matching tasks are reordered or highlighted according to the filter state

Verify the task list updates to show tasks in the selected status

title: Search and filter organization tasks

Submit the task form without entering a title
